evidence.observation: Pressure was 3.147 Torr near the end of the ramp at 100 sccm Ar, consistent with the preceding stable baseline.
Pressure has risen monotonically throughout growth to 3.526 Torr despite unchanged temperature and Ar setpoints.
Temperature 750.3 °C and Ar 99.8 sccm track setpoints of 750 °C and 100 sccm; controller still reports running.
Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed, so oxygen telemetry cannot distinguish air ingress from an exhaust restriction or another pressure disturbance.

args.missing_evidence: Expected growth-stage pressure profile and pressure tolerance; independent pressure verification, leak testing, and exhaust/pumping conductance checks to distinguish causes of the sustained rise. Sample characterization is not yet available.
